test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following shall communicate to the President all the decisions of the council of ministers under article 78?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Prime Minister.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• An Article 78 proceeding is **used to appeal the decision of a New York State or local agency to the New York courts**.
 
• Article 78 of the Constitution concerns **the duties of the Prime Minister** with respect to the furnishing of information to the President.
 
• In the Indian constitution, the prime minister is referenced in only four of its articles **(articles 74, 75, 78 and 366).**
 
• The prime minister can be a **member of the Lok Sabha or of the Rajya Sabha,** the upper house of parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A foreign minister is **a governmental minister for foreign affairs**.​ 
 
• The vice president of India is the **deputy to the cheif of State of the Republic of India. It** means **the president of India.**
 
• The Minister of Home Affairs is the** head of the Ministry of Home Affairs** of the Government of India.
